release_notes: Import from Binom via its v2 Public API: Admin -> Migrations pulls affiliate networks, offers, landings, domains, traffic sources and campaigns with their whole structure (default paths -> fallback streams, rules -> filtered streams, direct-URL offers -> real offers with weights) straight from a live Binom tracker — no dump file, just the tracker URL and an API key (never stored). Connection test with entity counts, dry-run preview, idempotent re-runs via binom_id columns (schema 79), and a report that names everything that could not travel exactly. Also fixed the panel 500s on session recordings: an ALTER swallowed during the v1.8.3 update left installs without the schema-78 columns; the self-heal now runs on a dedicated connection and records its reason in system_logs on failure. The October 2026 security banners are retired (the updater's PHP advisory stays). Migration 79 runs on update; suite 145/145.
